method.surface_samples: all triangle centers of untouched R07 Seed-42 PLY
method.reference_side_projection: X/Z mapped to REF-SEAM body polygon; Y quantized to 160 depth bins
method.cluster_rule: one-bin gaps closed; contiguous occupied depth bands counted
method.confirmed_hidden_body_signature: >=4 separated depth bands (covering sheet front/back plus body front/back)
method.limitations: Three bands are ambiguous at fused contacts; triangle-center sampling may undercount very thin layers.

conclusion.reason: Confirmed underlying four-layer geometry is sparse rather than continuous across the seam-defined face; removing all overhangs would therefore leave gaps requiring reconstruction.
